exact_cause: Kaggle temporarily failed DNS resolution for the Python package index. Pip exhausted its retries and could not resolve transformers>=4.53,<5, so the notebook stopped before model access, data preparation, training, or evaluation.
evidence: Temporary failure in name resolution while requesting /simple/transformers/.
No matching distribution found because the package index returned no versions.
CalledProcessError from the runtime dependency installation command.
smallest_safe_fix: Retry the pinned dependency installation at the notebook level with bounded exponential backoff in addition to pip's network retries, while keeping the same model, data, safety gates, and encrypted-secret design.
disposition: Infrastructure failure only. Do not activate the candidate. Relaunch privately after the bounded network-retry fix.
